title: VTC WSS: event delivery semantics
description: Delivery rules: fire-and-forget, not persisted. Rate limiting (VTCMediaStateEvent max 1/s/participant, VTCActiveSpeakerEvent max 2/s/call). Event ordering best-effort. Blocked-sender suppression for ring events. Subscription cleared on disconnect.
